objective: Lower-body strength maintenance during the BASE phase

explanation.what: Goblet squat, Romanian deadlift and standing calf raise, 3 sets each at moderate effort.
explanation.why: Maintains lower-body force and tendon resilience for running; scheduled 48 hours before Thursday's intervals at moderate RPE to keep interference low.

strength.purpose: Maintain lower-body strength and calf-Achilles capacity
strength.progressionRule: Add one or two reps per set until the top of the range is reached at target RPE in two consecutive sessions, then increase load by the smallest available increment.
strength.regressionRule: If reps are missed or RPE exceeds the target by more than 1.5 in two sessions, or pain is reported for the region, reduce load or switch to the listed alternative.

expectedInterference.notes: 48 hours before intervals at moderate effort.
